prompt: A call center's cost per call rose 20%, while wages stayed the same. Which is the strongest initial hypothesis?

options.text: Calls are likely taking longer, perhaps due to a new system or more complex issues.
options.feedback: Right. It commits to a likely cause that fits the facts, and it is testable: I'd check average handle time by call type.

options.text: It could be call length, staffing levels, overtime, systems, training or call mix.
options.feedback: This lists several causes without committing to the most likely one.

options.text: The new phone system is slowing agents down, so it should be replaced.
options.feedback: This states a cause as certain before any data has tested it.
This is too vague to test: it doesn't say what is wrong or what data would show it.

explanation: With flat wages, cost per call rises when calls take longer or agents sit idle. Handle time by call type tests the first.

distractor_flaws.M.shotgun_hypotheses: It could be call length, staffing levels, overtime, systems, training or call mix.
distractor_flaws.M.overconfident_hypothesis: The new phone system is slowing agents down, so it should be replaced.
